label: Respect of understanding: InAct x understanding, x is actually understanding something
term: the respect of understanding (the Respect parameter understanding of DeiFiliusOperationFromIntellect)
definition: understanding is one respect of the shared act/potency vocabulary: InAct x understanding means that x is actually understanding something (intelligere in actu, as the knower who is contemplating, Metaphysics IX.6), InPotency x understanding that x is in potency to understanding, and CanBe x understanding (POTENCY_3, DEF-CAPACITY-TO-BE) that x is able to be actually understanding. Explicitly identified PRIMITIVE: in Lean a parameter of type Respect, constrained only by the open premises that mention it. Examples: a geometer contemplating a proof is in act in this respect; the same geometer asleep has the capacity and is not in act (Aristotle's knower not contemplating). Non-examples: a stone (no capacity); a book containing a proof (it does not understand). Distinguishing conditions: (1) not having intellect (HAS_INTELLECT_1, DEF-HAS-INTELLECT): having intellect is a standing nature, being in act in this respect is its exercise; (2) not an immanent operation (7acc985a, Operates): Operates is a predicate of beings that covers understanding and willing alike, and the step from actually understanding to operating is the separate open premise 'Whatever is capable of understanding and actually understands has an immanent operation'; (3) not living (LIVING_1, LIVING_2, DEF-LIVING): no life predicate is defined from it; (4) not time-indexed: InAct x understanding says nothing of when or whether the understanding has temporal parts; (5) act sense (DISAMB-IN-ACT): InAct here is the nine's shared act predicate, which DEF-UNIVERSALLY-PERFECT reads as formal-or-virtual act; this definition does not specialize it. 'Actually understanding' in the examples above is the formal case. A being may be in act in this respect only virtually (containing an understander's perfection in a cause), and having the capacity to understand does not exclude that; the step from such act to an immanent operation is carried explicitly by the open premise 'Whatever is POTENCY_3 capable of understanding and IN_ACT_3 understanding has an immanent operation', not by this definition; (6) not an active power: CanBe x understanding is an ability to be actually understanding, the receptive capacity of the Metaphysics IX.6 knower (cf. De Anima III.4, the intellect as able to become its objects; attribution deferred), not an active power to produce an effect in another (ST I q.25 a.1). No record in the corpus yet carries the active/passive power distinction, so whether producing an effect is itself a CanBe respect is left open; the premise 'Whatever has the POTENCY_3 capacity to understand is IN_ACT_3 understanding or in POTENCY_2 to it' uses only this respect.
note: Stipulative analyst notion, attribution deferred: motivated by Aristotle's example of the knower who is or is not contemplating (Metaphysics IX.6, the passage of claim 4eb6f90c, read there for the analysis of potency, not as stating this definition) and by ST I q.18 a.3 ad 1 (understanding as an action that remains in the agent; no claim on file). Open semantic obligation: whether actually understanding at a being in potency in no respect involves succession (the timeless-agency question, see 7acc985a); the respect is not time-indexed, so nothing proved here settles it.
